_doc: Hand-written index of the DD30 experiments (~/dd30 on helix, synced to Talk/results/raw), read by build_index.py. groups: subsections of index.html, in talk order. experiments: group, status (current | pending | partly superseded | superseded | pilot | abandoned | check | smoke), a one-line note, and talk: true to list it under Talk although no talk series uses it. series: rows of several experiments merged into one table per figure, x is a column of runs.csv; dirs in priority order (the first experiment with an ok run for a (method, x) point wins); name_re and filter select the runs; talk: true puts the series (and the experiments it uses) into the Talk section, everything else goes to Other (hidden by default).

groups.title: Weak scaling (slides 1 and 7: the cost of robustness, scaling)
Backup: contrast, velocity, eigensolver tolerance, thresholds, shift
Pilots, superseded and abandoned
groups.note: Kept for reference; do not use their numbers in the talk without checking the flags and notes.

weak3d_P8.note: 3D weak scaling, 8 subdomains (channels fixed in space, contrast 1e6, 16^3 elements per subdomain, threshold 0.5, velocity 1 and 100)

weak3d_P64.note: 3D weak scaling, 64 subdomains; also the tolerance 1e-5 point of tolerance3d_P64

weak3d_P512.note: 3D weak scaling, 512 subdomains (32 nodes, queued); ini copies switched to mtype -2 before the start, see the commit note

weak2d_P16.note: 2D weak scaling, elliptic (meandering channels, 128^2 elements per subdomain, threshold 0.5), 16 subdomains

size3d_ldlt_P64.note: 3D size ladder of the two new variants (eta = omega, ring), 12^3..24^3 elements per subdomain, mtype -2; geneo_sz3_c12 (mtype 2) hung without aborting

size3d_rest_P64.note: 3D size ladder, the rest: GenEO 12^3..24^3 with mtype -2, saddle point 20^3/24^3, RAS 24^3

size3d_P64.note: First 3D size ladder (mtype 2): RAS 12-20^3, saddle point 12/16^3 and all methods at 16^3 are fine; the GenEO and new-variant runs that hung are redone in size3d_ldlt/rest; hit the time limit at 20^3

size2d_P16.note: 2D size ladder (16 subdomains, 64^2..512^2 elements per subdomain); GenEO and saddle point OOM at 512^2, redone in size2d_deferred_P16

size2d_deferred_P16.note: GenEO and saddle point at 256^2/512^2 with the deferred fine factorisation (3320310): same times, 512^2 now fits

velocity3d_P64.note: 3D velocity sweep 1..1e4 on the channels with the current settings (threshold 0.5, shift -1e-9, mtype -2), all methods incl. RAS and the ring; replaces velocity_P64

spectra_P64.note: Spectra (printed in the logs) of GenEO and the MS-GFEM variants with the current settings: 2D elliptic nev 60, 3D skyscrapers/random/channels nev 80; replaces the MS-GFEM spectra of elliptic2d_P64 / elliptic_P64 (shift -1e-3)

elliptic2d_P64.note: 2D elliptic, 64 subdomains, nev 20/60 with the spectra printed. GenEO rows fine; the MS-GFEM rows ran at shift -1e-3 (flagged), their spectra are redone in spectra_P64

elliptic_P64.note: 3D elliptic (skyscrapers, random, channels), nev 40/80, Lanczos counts and spectra; GenEO and saddle point rows are fine, the new variants ran at shift -1e-3 (flagged): for random/channels use shift_P64 (-1e-9), spectra in spectra_P64

velocity_P64.note: First velocity sweep (nev 40, the new variants at shift -1e-3, flagged): GenEO 10 -> 139 iterations; replaced by velocity3d_P64

shift_P64.note: The new variants on the elliptic random/channels problems at shifts -1e-6 and -1e-9: with -1e-9 they match the saddle point (21-22 / 8 iterations), the ring needs -1e-9 on the channels

contrast3d_P64.note: 3D contrast sweep 1..1e8 (velocity 1) with the current settings; the 1e6 point is velocity3d_P64 at v 1; replaces the channels_3d pilot

sweeps2d_P64.note: 2D, 64 subdomains: contrast 1e2..1e8, velocity 1..1000, Lanczos tolerance 1e-2..1e-4; all spectral methods 6-12 iterations, RAS 147-196

tolerance3d_P64.note: 3D channels, Lanczos tolerance 1e-2..1e-4: always 10 iterations, 1e-2 saves ~10%

check_shift_P64.note: Checks with the shift -1e-9: the checkerboard velocity gap is gone, the ring really has more small eigenvalues (nev 80 spectra), threshold 0.5 at 64 subdomains

thresh_P64.note: Threshold calibration (0.01 for the two-sided variants, 0.5/1 for the saddle point) at shift -1e-3; replaced by the common threshold 0.5 (check_shift_P64)

pilot_3d.note: 3D pilot on the checkerboard (too easy: isolated inclusions, RAS 66 iterations), nev 20/40/80, shift -1e-3

channels_3d.note: Channels pilot, contrast 1..1e6, velocity 1/100, nev 40, shift -1e-3 (the ring's apparent non-robustness, 64 iterations, was the shift); replaced by contrast3d_P64

spectra_3d.note: Spectra (nev 80) on the checkerboard of the pilot, the two-sided variants printed at shift -1e-7

size_3d.note: First 3D size ladder on the checkerboard, nev 40, shift -1e-3; superseded by size3d_*

weak_P8.note: First 3D weak scaling (nev 40 fixed, shift -1e-3); with the channels fixed in space 8 subdomains need ~100 eigenvectors; superseded by weak3d_*

weak_P64.note: First 3D weak scaling, 64 subdomains (nev 40/80, shift -1e-3); its nev 80 spectra showed the ring's extra small eigenvalues

weak_P8s.note: Weak scaling with the channels scaled with the subdomains: dropped (user decision 2026-11-15: fixed problem)

weak_P512.note: Old 512-subdomain job, cancelled before it ran: its ini and executable copies were stale (see NOTE)

smoke.note: Smoke test of the helix setup (one node, 16 ranks)

series.title: 3D weak scaling, velocity 100 (convection-dominated background)
series.note: Convection-diffusion: the background (kappa 1) is convection-dominated (mesh Peclet ~5), the channels (contrast 1e6) are not. Fixed in space, 16^3 elements per subdomain, threshold 0.5. Shift-invert factorisation mtype 2 up to 216, mtype -2 at 512 (same cost at 16^3). Slide 1 (cost of robustness) is its 216 point.

series.title: 3D weak scaling, velocity 1 (diffusion-dominated)
series.note: As the velocity 100 series, but diffusion-dominated everywhere (mesh Peclet ~0.05 in the background).

series.title: 2D weak scaling, elliptic
series.note: Meandering channels (1e6) in a Matern background, fixed in space, 128^2 elements per subdomain, threshold 0.5.

series.title: 3D: cost against subdomain size (64 subdomains)
series.note: Channels, contrast 1e6, velocity 1, threshold 0.5, 8 ranks per node. The new variants and GenEO with mtype -2; RAS and the saddle point partly from the first ladder.

series.title: 3D velocity sweep on the channels (64 subdomains, threshold 0.5)
series.note: GenEO only sees the diffusion, MS-GFEM's harmonic functions see the convection. Current settings (shift -1e-9, mtype -2).

series.title: 3D velocity sweep, first version (nev 40)
series.note: Superseded by the series above; the new variants at shift -1e-3 (flagged).

series.title: 3D elliptic problems, nev 40 (64 subdomains)
series.note: The new variants at shift -1e-9 from shift_P64 where available (random, channels); skyscrapers only at -1e-3 (flagged).
